acceptanceCriteria: A store initialised from an import map can record an amended map through a journaled, reviewed mutation.
Existing ticket identities stay stable across the amendment; a conflicting amendment is refused with a typed code.
Focused tests cover amend, conflict refusal and replay.
body: Residual from lane tw-1022m (PR beamfall/corvint#1543, V1-0398). The durable writer for imported stores (CTS-V0-014..017) fixes the import map at genesis; a later source rename or added source queue cannot be recorded without re-initialising the store.
title: corvint-tasks import map cannot change after genesis
